nodes.lean_statement: let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∃ (h g : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (s t : ℕ → ℝ) (α θ₀ β θ₁ : ℝ), 0 < α ∧ α < θ₀ ∧ θ₀ < β ∧ β < θ₁ ∧ θ₁ < 1 ∧ ContinuousOn h K ∧ Set.InjOn h K ∧ IsOpen (h '' U) ∧ ContinuousOn g K ∧ Set.InjOn g K ∧ IsOpen (g '' U) ∧ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ⊆ h '' U ∧ g '' K ⊆ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, ContinuousOn (r θ) (Set.Ioi 1)) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → r θ ρ ∉ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → r θ ρ ∈ h '' U) ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, r θ 2 = h (e θ)) ∧ (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, θ ≠ ψ → Disjoint (r θ '' Set.Ioc 1 2) (r ψ '' Set.Ioc 1 2)) ∧ y₀ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ y₁ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r θ₀) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₀) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r θ₁) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₁) ∧ Function.Injective a ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, a j ∈ g '' S) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, s n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ t n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds α) ∧ Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds β) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, ∃ u v : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, u n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧ v n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (s n) (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (t n) (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)))

nodes.title: Three common boundary targets obstruct path-connectedness
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ X : Set ℂ, (let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∃ (h g : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (s t : ℕ → ℝ) (α θ₀ β θ₁ : ℝ), 0 < α ∧ α < θ₀ ∧ θ₀ < β ∧ β < θ₁ ∧ θ₁ < 1 ∧ ContinuousOn h K ∧ Set.InjOn h K ∧ IsOpen (h '' U) ∧ ContinuousOn g K ∧ Set.InjOn g K ∧ IsOpen (g '' U) ∧ X ⊆ h '' U ∧ g '' K ⊆ X ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, ContinuousOn (r θ) (Set.Ioi 1)) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → r θ ρ ∉ X) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → r θ ρ ∈ h '' U) ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, r θ 2 = h (e θ)) ∧ (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, θ ≠ ψ → Disjoint (r θ '' Set.Ioc 1 2) (r ψ '' Set.Ioc 1 2)) ∧ y₀ ∈ X ∧ y₁ ∈ X ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r θ₀) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₀) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r θ₁) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₁) ∧ Function.Injective a ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, a j ∈ g '' S) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, s n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ t n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds α) ∧ Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds β) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, ∃ u v : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, u n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧ v n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (s n) (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (t n) (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)))) → ¬ IsPathConnected X

nodes.title: A disk chart matching an exterior homeomorphism
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ X}), IsCompact X → (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) → (∀ w : ℂ, 1 < ‖w‖ → ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ (‖P w‖ + 1) * (‖P w‖ + 2)) → let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun θ ρ => P ((ρ : ℂ) * e θ); ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn h K ∧ Set.InjOn h K ∧ IsOpen (h '' U) ∧ X ⊆ h '' U ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, ContinuousOn (r θ) (Set.Ioi 1)) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → r θ ρ ∉ X) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → (r θ ρ ∈ h '' U ↔ ρ < 2)) ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, r θ 2 = h (e θ)) ∧ (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, θ ≠ ψ → Disjoint (r θ '' Set.Ioc 1 2) (r ψ '' Set.Ioc 1 2))

nodes.title: One exterior coordinate with landing rays and three common boundary targets
nodes.lean_statement: IsCompact LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar → let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∃ (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar}) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (s t : ℕ → ℝ), let r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun θ ρ => P ((ρ : ℂ) * e θ); (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) ∧ (∀ w : ℂ, 1 < ‖w‖ → ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ (‖P w‖ + 1) * (‖P w‖ + 2)) ∧ ContinuousOn g K ∧ Set.InjOn g K ∧ IsOpen (g '' U) ∧ g '' K ⊆ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ y₀ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ y₁ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r ((3 : ℝ) / 8)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₀) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₁) ∧ Function.Injective a ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, a j ∈ g '' S) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, s n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ t n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds ((371 : ℝ) / 1023)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds ((404 : ℝ) / 1023)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, ∃ u v : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, 1 < u n ∧ 1 < v n) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (s n) (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (t n) (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)))

nodes.title: Put a convergent ray-point sequence inside the prescribed radial interval

nodes.title: Paths with alternating endpoints in an embedded disk intersect
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (σ θ₀ τ θ₁ : ℝ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ContinuousOn h K → Set.InjOn h K → 0 ≤ σ → σ < θ₀ → θ₀ < τ → τ < θ₁ → θ₁ < 1 → ∀ (P : Path (h (e θ₀)) (h (e θ₁))) (Q : Path (h (e σ)) (h (e τ))), (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → P ξ ∈ h '' U) → (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → Q ξ ∈ h '' U) → ¬ Disjoint (Set.range P) (Set.range Q)

nodes.title: A joining path avoids one of three embedded-disk boundary targets
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (a : Fin 3 → ℂ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; ContinuousOn g K → Set.InjOn g K → IsOpen (g '' U) → g '' K ⊆ X → IsPathConnected X → y₀ ∈ X → y₁ ∈ X → y₀ ∉ g '' U → y₁ ∉ g '' U → Function.Injective a → (∀ j : Fin 3, a j ∈ g '' S) → ∃ (j : Fin 3) (γ : Path y₀ y₁), Set.range γ ⊆ X ∧ a j ∉ Set.range γ

nodes.title: A common limit of interleaving ray families lies on every joining path
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (y₀ y₁ A : ℂ) (s t u v : ℕ → ℝ) (α θ₀ β θ₁ : ℝ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); 0 < α → α < θ₀ → θ₀ < β → β < θ₁ → θ₁ < 1 → ContinuousOn h K → Set.InjOn h K → IsOpen (h '' U) → X ⊆ h '' U → (∀ θ : ℝ, ContinuousOn (r θ) (Set.Ioi 1)) → (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → r θ ρ ∉ X) → (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → r θ ρ ∈ h '' U) → (∀ θ : ℝ, r θ 2 = h (e θ)) → (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, θ ≠ ψ → Disjoint (r θ '' Set.Ioc 1 2) (r ψ '' Set.Ioc 1 2)) → y₀ ∈ X → y₁ ∈ X → A ∈ X → Filter.Tendsto (r θ₀) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₀) → Filter.Tendsto (r θ₁) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₁) → (∀ n : ℕ, s n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ t n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ u n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧ v n ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2) → Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds α) → Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds β) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (s n) (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds A) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (t n) (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds A) → ∀ γ : Path y₀ y₁, Set.range γ ⊆ X → A ∈ Set.range γ

nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ X}), IsCompact X → (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) → (∀ w : ℂ, 1 < ‖w‖ → ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ (‖P w‖ + 1) * (‖P w‖ + 2)) → let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let q : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => P ((2 : ℂ) * u); ContinuousOn q S ∧ Set.InjOn q S ∧ ∃ D : Set ℂ, IsOpen D ∧ Bornology.IsBounded D ∧ D.Nonempty ∧ frontier D = q '' S ∧ X ⊆ D ∧ (∀ w : ℂ, 1 < ‖w‖ → (P w ∈ D ↔ ‖w‖ < 2))

nodes.title: Continuity, avoidance, and disjointness of exterior polar rays
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ X}), (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) → let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun θ ρ => P ((ρ : ℂ) * e θ); (∀ θ : ℝ, ContinuousOn (r θ) (Set.Ioi 1)) ∧ (∀ θ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → r θ ρ ∉ X) ∧ (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, θ ≠ ψ → Disjoint (r θ '' Set.Ioc 1 2) (r ψ '' Set.Ioc 1 2))

nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (q : ℂ → ℂ) (D : Set ℂ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; ContinuousOn q S → Set.InjOn q S → IsOpen D → Bornology.IsBounded D → D.Nonempty → frontier D = q '' S → ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn h K ∧ Set.InjOn h K ∧ h '' U = D ∧ (∀ u ∈ S, h u = q u)

nodes.lean_statement: IsCompact LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar → let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∃ (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar}) (W : Set ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (s t : ℕ → ℝ), let r : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun θ ρ => P ((ρ : ℂ) * e θ); (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) ∧ (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (max 1 ‖(LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Tantibar (P (w : ℂ)))^[n] (P (w : ℂ))‖) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.log ‖(w : ℂ)‖))) ∧ IsOpen W ∧ IsConnected W ∧ IsCompact (closure W) ∧ closure W ⊆ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ Nonempty ({z : ℂ // z ∈ S} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∈ frontier W}) ∧ y₀ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ y₁ ∈ LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Mandelbar ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r ((3 : ℝ) / 8)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₀) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (r ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y₁) ∧ Function.Injective a ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, a j ∈ frontier W) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, s n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ t n ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds ((371 : ℝ) / 1023)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds ((404 : ℝ) / 1023)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, ∃ u v : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, 1 < u n ∧ 1 < v n) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (s n) (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => r (t n) (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j)))

nodes.title: Lift a path through a compact embedded disk

nodes.title: A simple disk crosscut meets a path with alternating endpoints
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (σ θ₀ τ θ₁ : ℝ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); 0 ≤ σ → σ < θ₀ → θ₀ < τ → τ < θ₁ → θ₁ < 1 → ∀ (L : Path (e θ₀) (e θ₁)) (Q : Path (e σ) (e τ)), Function.Injective (fun ξ : unitInterval => L ξ) → (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → L ξ ∈ U) → (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → Q ξ ∈ U) → ¬ Disjoint (Set.range L) (Set.range Q)

nodes.title: Join truncated rays through a ball while avoiding a prescribed set
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (D F : Set ℂ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (A : ℂ) (δ u v : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioi 1) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Ioi 1) → 0 < δ → 1 < u → u < 2 → 1 < v → v < 2 → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → f ρ ∈ D) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → g ρ ∈ D) → f u ∈ Metric.ball A δ → g v ∈ Metric.ball A δ → Metric.ball A δ ⊆ D \ F → Disjoint (f '' Set.Icc u 2) F → Disjoint (g '' Set.Icc v 2) F → ∃ Q : Path (f 2) (g 2), (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → Q ξ ∈ D) ∧ Disjoint F (Set.range Q)

nodes.title: The image of the radius-two exterior has a bounded complement and the expected frontier
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (P : ℂ → ℂ), let U : Set (OnePoint ℂ) := {z | z.elim True (fun w : ℂ => 1 < ‖w‖)}; let V : Set (OnePoint ℂ) := {z | z.elim True (fun c : ℂ => c ∉ X)}; IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ K : U ≃ₜ V, (K ⟨OnePoint.infty, True.intro⟩ : OnePoint ℂ) = OnePoint.infty → (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, (K ⟨((w : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ), w.property⟩ : OnePoint ℂ) = (P (w : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ)) → let A : Set ℂ := P '' {w : ℂ | 2 ≤ ‖w‖}; IsClosed A ∧ Bornology.IsBounded Aᶜ ∧ frontier A = P '' Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 2

nodes.title: Extend the exterior homeomorphism at infinity
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Set ℂ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (H : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖} ≃ₜ {z : ℂ // z ∉ X}), IsCompact X → (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, P (w : ℂ) = (H w : ℂ)) → (∀ w : ℂ, 1 < ‖w‖ → ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ (‖P w‖ + 1) * (‖P w‖ + 2)) → let U : Set (OnePoint ℂ) := {z | z.elim True (fun w : ℂ => 1 < ‖w‖)}; let V : Set (OnePoint ℂ) := {z | z.elim True (fun c : ℂ => c ∉ X)}; IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ ∃ K : U ≃ₜ V, (K ⟨OnePoint.infty, True.intro⟩ : OnePoint ℂ) = OnePoint.infty ∧ (∀ w : {z : ℂ // 1 < ‖z‖}, (K ⟨((w : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ), w.property⟩ : OnePoint ℂ) = (P (w : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ))

nodes.title: Norm-preserving radial extension of a circle homeomorphism
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ b : (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1) ≃ₜ (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1), ∃ R : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ, (∀ z : ℂ, ‖R z‖ = ‖z‖) ∧ (∀ u : Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, R (u : ℂ) = (b u : ℂ))

nodes.title: A Jordan-domain disk chart without prescribed boundary parametrization
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (q : ℂ → ℂ) (D : Set ℂ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; ContinuousOn q S → Set.InjOn q S → IsOpen D → Bornology.IsBounded D → D.Nonempty → frontier D = q '' S → ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn f K ∧ Set.InjOn f K ∧ f '' U = D ∧ f '' S = q '' S

nodes.title: Finite-iterate logarithmic lower bound for large parameters
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (c : ℂ), 2 < ‖c‖ → ∀ n : ℕ, Real.log ‖c‖ + (1 - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) * Real.log (1 - 1 / ‖c‖) ≤ Real.log (max 1 ‖(LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Tantibar c)^[n] c‖) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n

nodes.title: Uniform finite-iterate logarithmic upper bound
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (c : ℂ) (n : ℕ), Real.log (max 1 ‖(LeanEval.ComplexAnalysis.Tantibar c)^[n] c‖) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ Real.log (‖c‖ + 1) + (1 - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) * Real.log (‖c‖ + 2)

nodes.title: Approximate an avoiding disk path by a finite segment chain
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℂ) (F : Set ℂ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖b‖ = 1 → a ≠ b → IsCompact F → ∀ (P : Path a b), (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → P ξ ∈ U) → Disjoint (Set.range P) F → ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ), 2 ≤ n ∧ v 0 = a ∧ v (Fin.last n) = b ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, segment ℝ (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ⊆ (U ∪ {a, b}) \ F

nodes.title: Extract an injective path from a finite segment chain
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℂ) (S : Set ℂ), a ≠ b → ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ), v 0 = a → v (Fin.last n) = b → (∀ i : Fin n, segment ℝ (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ⊆ S) → ∃ L : Path a b, Function.Injective (fun ξ : unitInterval => L ξ) ∧ Set.range L ⊆ S

nodes.title: Circular completion of a disk path and its local boundary geometry
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (σ θ₀ τ θ₁ : ℝ), let U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1; let S := Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1; let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); 0 ≤ σ → σ < θ₀ → θ₀ < τ → τ < θ₁ → θ₁ < 1 → ∀ L : Path (e θ₀) (e θ₁), (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → L ξ ∈ U) → ∃ R : Path (e θ₁) (e θ₀), Function.Injective (fun ξ : unitInterval => R ξ) ∧ Set.range R = e '' Set.Icc θ₁ (1 + θ₀) ∧ Set.range R ⊆ S ∧ Set.range L ∩ Set.range R = {e θ₀, e θ₁} ∧ Set.range L ∪ Set.range R ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 ∧ e σ ∈ Set.range R ∧ e τ ∈ S ∧ e τ ∉ Set.range L ∪ Set.range R ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ (Set.range L ∪ Set.range R) ∩ Metric.ball (e σ) ε = S ∩ Metric.ball (e σ) ε

nodes.title: Identify an interior circle cap and a free boundary point on opposite sides
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (J Ω E : Set ℂ) (b c : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), J ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 → IsOpen Ω → IsOpen E → Disjoint Ω E → Ω ∪ E = Jᶜ → Bornology.IsBounded Ω → frontier Ω = J → b ∈ J → c ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 → c ∉ J → 0 < ε → J ∩ Metric.ball b ε = Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 ∩ Metric.ball b ε → Metric.ball b ε ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ Ω ∧ c ∈ E

nodes.title: Full Jordan separation for two injective arcs meeting at their endpoints
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (a d : ℂ) (L : Path a d) (R : Path d a), Function.Injective (fun ξ : unitInterval => L ξ) → Function.Injective (fun ξ : unitInterval => R ξ) → Set.range L ∩ Set.range R = {a, d} → ∃ Ω E : Set ℂ, IsOpen Ω ∧ IsOpen E ∧ IsConnected Ω ∧ IsConnected E ∧ Disjoint Ω E ∧ Ω ∪ E = (Set.range L ∪ Set.range R)ᶜ ∧ Bornology.IsBounded Ω ∧ ¬ Bornology.IsBounded E ∧ frontier Ω = Set.range L ∪ Set.range R ∧ frontier E = Set.range L ∪ Set.range R

nodes.title: First and last contacts lie outside the open region
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (H W : Set ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (η : Path y₀ y₁), IsClosed H → IsOpen W → W ⊆ H → y₀ ∉ W → y₁ ∉ W → (∃ t : unitInterval, η t ∈ W) → ∃ u v : unitInterval, u < v ∧ η u ∈ H \ W ∧ η v ∈ H \ W ∧ (∀ t : unitInterval, t < u → η t ∉ H) ∧ (∀ t : unitInterval, v < t → η t ∉ H)

nodes.title: Controlled splicing between two contact times
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (H W : Set ℂ) (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (η : Path y₀ y₁) (u v : unitInterval) (c : Path (η u) (η v)), u < v → (∀ t : unitInterval, t < u → η t ∉ H) → (∀ t : unitInterval, v < t → η t ∉ H) → Set.range c ⊆ H → Set.range c ∩ (H \ W) ⊆ ({η u, η v} : Set ℂ) → ∃ γ : Path y₀ y₁, Set.range γ ⊆ Set.range η ∪ H ∧ Set.range γ ∩ (H \ W) ⊆ ({η u, η v} : Set ℂ)

nodes.title: Complete a landing ray with exact image and half-open containment
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (D : Set ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (y : ℂ), y ∈ D → ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioi 1) → Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds y) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 1 < ρ → ρ < 2 → f ρ ∈ D) → ∃ L : Path y (f 2), Set.range L = ({y} : Set ℂ) ∪ (f '' Set.Ioc 1 2) ∧ (∀ q : unitInterval, (q : ℝ) < 1 → L q ∈ D)

nodes.title: Control the image and interior of a three-path bridge
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (D : Set ℂ) (a b y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (L : Path y₀ a) (γ : Path y₀ y₁) (R : Path y₁ b), (∀ q : unitInterval, (q : ℝ) < 1 → L q ∈ D) → Set.range γ ⊆ D → (∀ q : unitInterval, (q : ℝ) < 1 → R q ∈ D) → Set.range ((L.symm.trans γ).trans R) = (Set.range L ∪ Set.range γ) ∪ Set.range R ∧ (∀ ξ : unitInterval, 0 < (ξ : ℝ) → (ξ : ℝ) < 1 → ((L.symm.trans γ).trans R) ξ ∈ D)
